Question: What first lien net leverage level limits incremental commitments under the accordion?

Answer: The first lien net leverage level that limits incremental commitments under the accordion is a Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio not to exceed 3.00 to 1.00 on a pro forma basis [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 76; c0839], [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 101; c1067], [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 38; c0437].
